WITH matching_workflows_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    sp.remaingb,
    sp.proccpu,
    sp.procgpu,
    s.insurstat
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    AVG(remaingb) as avg_remaingb,
    AVG(CASE WHEN proccpu IS NOT NULL AND procgpu IS NOT NULL 
             THEN (proccpu - procgpu) END) as avg_cpu_minus_gpu
  FROM matching_workflows_sites
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) as overall_avg_remaingb
  FROM group_averages
),
paired_results AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.zoneref,
    ga.insurstat,
    ga.avg_remaingb,
    ga.avg_cpu_minus_gpu,
    CASE WHEN oa.overall_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL AND ga.avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
         THEN ga.avg_remaingb / oa.overall_avg_remaingb
         ELSE NULL END as division
  FROM group_averages ga
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  insurstat,
  avg_remaingb,
  avg_cpu_minus_gpu,
  division
FROM paired_results
ORDER BY CASE WHEN division IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, division DESC
LIMIT 10
